permitDetails.rightOfEntryClause: The Permittee shall allow any duly authorized agent of the Agency upon the presentation of credentials, at reasonable times: to enter the Permittee’s property where actual or potential effluent, emission or noise sources are located or where any activity is to be conducted pursuant to this permit; to have access to and copy any records required to be kept under the terms and conditions of this permit; to inspect ... such equipment and any equipment required to be kept, used, operated, calibrated and maintained under this permit; to obtain and remove samples of any discharge or emission of pollutants; and to enter and utilize any photographic, recording, testing, monitoring or other equipment for the purpose of preserving, testing, monitoring, or recording any activity, discharge, or emission authorized by this permit.
permitDetails.extractionNotes: Selected Application No. 21050040 as permitNumber; I.D. No. 031471AEN recorded as stateFacilityID. Permit lists equipment as 'Forty-Nine (49) 3,000 kW ...' and 'Two (2) 500 kW ...' but also references generator IDs EG1 – EG13 in Condition 15; the equipment list at the top did not provide individual EG labels for all units.

generatorSets.referenceNumber: Forty-Nine (49) 3,000 kW (4,393 BHP) Diesel Emergency Generators
generatorSets.fuelChangePermitTrigger: The use of any other fuel in any of the engines powering the Emergency Generators may require that the Permittee first obtain a construction permit from the Illinois EPA and then perform stack testing to verify compliance with all applicable requirements.
generatorSets.operatingHoursPerUnitRollingWindow: Compliance determined on a daily basis from the sum of the data for the current day plus the preceding 364 days (running 365 days total).
generatorSets.allowedOperatingModes: Any operation other than emergency operation, maintenance and testing, emergency demand response, and operation in non-emergency situations for 50 hours per year, as described in 40 CFR 60.4211(f)(1) through (3), is prohibited.
generatorSets.extractionNotes: Operating hours limit specified as a combined annual limit for all 49 generators (1,793 hours/year). Emission tables for this group are provided in the permit. NSPS Subpart IIII and NESHAP Subpart ZZZZ applicability stated. Opacity: 35 Ill. Adm. Code 212.123(a) 30% (also NSPS/40 CFR 89.113 mode-specific limits listed elsewhere in the permit).
